message.content:
Pillow covers of man-made fibers fall under heading 6304, "other furnishing articles." Within 6304.92 ("not knitted or crocheted, of other textile materials"), the subheading for non-cotton materials is 6304.92.0000. A CBP ruling on similar polyester woven pillow covers classified them in 6304.92.0000, which I am recalling rather than quoting.

The alternative is 9404.90, which covers pillows and cushions. Covers without a filling are not "articles fitted with springs or stuffed," so heading 6304 applies rather than 9404. Cotton covers would go to 6304.91, but this one is polyester, so 6304.92 is correct.

The full statistical code is 6304.92.0000.

{"hts_code": "6304.92.0000", "reason": "Unfilled decorative pillow cover of woven 100% polyester is a non-knitted furnishing article of man-made (non-cotton) textile material, classified in heading 6304, subheading 6304.92."}
